title: VTC Groups — Managers — Add — payload
description: A group manager, or an administrator who manages every group, appoints a community member a manager of one group: an access-control resource grant of `vtc.groups.manage` qualified to that group. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Managers — Add — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/managers/add/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/managers/add/0.1#response.

managers.description: The group's managers after the appointment. Entries holding `vtc.groups.manage` qualified to this group, read from the access-control list; administrators who manage every group are not listed.
